plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Fire Suppression, Fire Technology, AAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/fire-technology-fire-suppression-aas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Fire Science Technology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnote 1 on this page as 'See program recommendations and approved General Education list for the AAS/BAS Degree' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with that definition in choice_note; see advisor. The 1st-semester grid presents FT 101 or FT 102 as alternatives (course list confirms 'or'); the 3rd-semester grid presents COM 113 or COM 101 as alternatives (course list confirms 'or') — both modeled as OR choice slots. Students completing the Fire and Rescue Academy may apply Fire Academy credits toward this degree. Pathway to the BAS in Emergency Management and Homeland Security. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
